script: Now, growing from a first job to a career. Stage one is your first three months. Build samples, and get your first two or three reviews. The goal is trust and proof. Stage two is months three to six. Raise your prices slightly, and ask for repeat work. The goal is a few regular clients. Stage three is months six to twelve. Offer a package, such as a monthly social media care plan. The goal is predictable monthly income. Stage four is year two onwards. Specialise, train others, or build a small team. Once your first skill earns, add one related skill every six months, because each new skill raises your value to the clients you already have. Let us make a simple weekly review. On Friday afternoon, open your notebook and write three lines. The first line is what you delivered this week. The second line is what you earned, or what you invested in your learning. The third line is one thing you will change next week. Keep the review short, about ten minutes.
